verdict.rationale: First-party docs directly describe durable agents: every step and tool call is checkpointed, so a process that dies at step 7 of 12 resumes at step 7 (inngest-docs-21, inngest-docs-33). Model calls can be wrapped as steps via step.ai.wrap() (inngest-docs-22), and a dedicated guide makes each ReAct loop iteration a durable, retriable step (inngest-docs-23). Per-step memoization and default retries round this out (inngest-docs-26, inngest-docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent loops specifically survive mid-run crashes (community reports cover general job reliability only).
